top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Breastfeeding Provisions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(25))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Information needs to be added in the operational policies/parent handbook regarding provisions for breastfeeding mothers, and their right to breastfeed or provide breast milk.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not been documenting their monthly maintenance inspections.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.
